source.idea: pad the sorted MoE rows to 4 per expert once there are >= 2 per expert so MLX's GatherQMM selects gather_qmm_rhs; pad rows are spread over the experts (e % E), read x row 0 and are dropped after the unsort

mlx_rule_checked.condition: M == 1 && B >= 16 && right_sorted_ && B / E >= 4 -> gather_qmm_rhs (NAX variant on M5 for bf16, bm 32 when M/E < 64); else gather_qmm if M >= vector_limit; else gather_qmv
mlx_rule_checked.dense_gather_mm: GatherMM::eval_gpu takes gather_mm_rhs for every sorted M == 1 gather: no rows-per-expert cliff

modifications: Re-expressed in Python inside QuantizedSwitchLinear.__call__ (per projection), not in a model-specific MoE function: no caller or model-name branching.

Pad rows repeat the LAST sorted row (expert id and activation) instead of being spread over e % E: the rows stay sorted with no re-sort, no expert outside the routed set is touched, and the outputs are sliced to the real rows before activation/unsort.

Threshold is a rows-per-expert floor read at call time (MLX2_MOE_RHS_PAD_MIN_ROWS, default 3, 0 = off); the expert count is the bank's own (weight.shape[0]). The disk-streamed StreamedQuantizedSwitchLinear overrides __call__ and is not padded.
default: on at 3 rows/expert from 2026-10-01 (Pierre's decision; MLX2_MOE_RHS_PAD_MIN_ROWS=0 turns it off); implemented, selected, unqualified until the next qualification campaign

validation.ttft_floor3: Nemotron-3.5 Lightning 8-bit T 72-84: -5..-13%; Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 4-bit T 96-120: -12..-23%; no measured loss elsewhere
validation.ttft_floor2: adds Qwen T 72-84 (-5..-11%) but Nemotron T=48 +11% (loss)
validation.greedy: not bit-identical when padded; token divergence at step 15-16 on T=80 prompts; identical tokens on T=48 (Nemotron) and T=112 (Qwen)
validation.tests: tests/test_moe_rhs_stream_pad.py (CPU index/order/counter tests; Metal bit test gated by MLX2_RUN_METAL_TESTS)
